title: Monte Carlo reconstruction of symmetry-twisted partition function ratios: the critical 3D Ising
summary: We introduce a Monte Carlo strategy for directly estimating partition function ratios between distinct global sectors of a lattice theory. It enlarges the configuration space to sample an interpolating family whose endpoints are the desired sectors, and uses flat histogram methods to reconstruct the corresponding free energy difference.
